summary.en: Check subtitle timing, line breaks, readability, and agreement with the source.

triggers: fix caption timing and line breaks
exclusions: A request for finished burned-in video captions

required_inputs.description: SRT, VTT, or timestamped subtitle text
Source transcript or audio and requested caption conventions

workflow.instruction: Parse cue structure and detect invalid ranges, overlaps, ordering errors, and empty cues.
Compare words against the supplied transcript or accessible audio and preserve speaker meaning.
Review reading speed, line breaks, punctuation, speaker labels, and relevant sound descriptions against the requested convention.
Return corrected subtitle text with a change summary and clearly identify timing checks that need audiovisual review.

deliverables.name: Corrected subtitle file
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Retains valid cue syntax and records any uncertain transcription

deliverables.name: Subtitle QC report
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Lists timing, text, readability, and unverified audio issues

limitations: Without audio, transcription correctness cannot be fully verified.
Platform-specific limits should come from provided or verified specifications.
permission_boundaries: Do not burn captions into video, upload media, or publish without an explicit request.
Do not invent inaudible speech or disclose sensitive audio content beyond the task.
